thread:
jules: Heads up 1: our weekly KPI snapshot shows webinar-to-lead conversion plunged from ~12% (Thu) to ~5% (Fri). Pulled the dashboard card (dashboard/redwood-launch -> 'webinar funnel'). Anyone notice changes to links, promos, or routing? :thinking:

ana: saw that too. I'll do a quick UTM/source breakout from the raw events.

kevin: we changed the preview image for the launch post Friday morning, but no CTA copy changes. Also ran an internal newsletter at 9am.

ops-bot: cron-etl: raw.webinar_events refreshed (s3://exports/webinar_events/3437771234_2026-03-21.csv). rows=5870; status=OK

ana: ad-hoc query (ran):
```
SELECT source, count(*) as visits, sum(is_lead) as leads
FROM raw.webinar_events
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-20' AND '2026-03-21'
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY visits DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Results: social-shortlink: visits=520, leads=2; direct: visits=310, leads=28; google-cpc: visits=2200, leads=200; newsletter: visits=880, leads=70. There's a big chunk from social-shortlink with almost zero attribution -> that's likely dragging the overall rate down.

jules: social-shortlink = the bit.ly we used for the Twitter thread? We usually pass UTMs through that.

kevin: yes, used short.red/launch. Ops mentioned a redirect rule last week that might strip query params on follow. @lia any idea?

lia: checked redirect logs: short.red/launch -> https://redwood.ai/events/launch?utm_campaign=launch_q1&utm_source=twitter then our CDN normalized to the clean URL without query params on 2026-03-20 08:14:22. So ~520 visits lost UTM.

ana: that explains it. Estimated fixed conversion (if attributed) ~10.5%, matches baseline.

jules: immediate fixes: 1) lia to update redirect to preserve query string (done); 2) kevin to repost social with full UTM'd long link via scheduled tweet (or use tweet cards); 3) ana to backfill attribution in analytics where possible and annotate dashboard.

lia: redirect change deployed at 2026-03-21T11:40Z.

kevin: will queue a repost at 12:15.

ana: I'll run a backfill job to join raw click logs to the webinar events and flag redirected hits with original_utms=TRUE; will update metrics on Monday morning.

jules: thanks y'all. Adding a note on the KPI board: "Friday conversion dip due to UTM stripping by shortlink; fix deployed and repost scheduled; backfill in progress." Closing the thread unless anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
